component.name: Tml
component.summary: Verified installer for Tor Browser, Mullvad Browser, and LibreWolf

description.p: Tml gets three privacy-focused browsers - Tor Browser, Mullvad Browser, and LibreWolf - onto your system the way a careful person would do it by hand: fetch the current official release, check its GPG signature against a fingerprint pinned in Tml itself (not whatever happens to be in your keyring), and only then unpack it. A failed check deletes the download instead of installing it.

Once a browser is in, Tml gets out of the way. Each one gets its own ordinary application-menu entry and opens like any other installed app - there's no launcher screen inside Tml, no bundled runtime the browser depends on, and nothing checking in over the network on its own. Updating, verifying, or sandboxing a browser with AppArmor are all things you ask for from the menu, never things that happen by themselves.

ul.li: Every download is checked against a pinned GPG key fingerprint in an isolated keyring, never your system's default one
A failed verification deletes the download; nothing unverified is ever installed
Optional AppArmor confinement per browser, generated and loaded on request
An existing browser profile is preserved across reinstalls and updates, not wiped
On-demand update checks - a menu click, never a background timer

description.p: Tml is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Tor Project, Mullvad, or the LibreWolf project. "Tor", "Mullvad", and "LibreWolf" are the trademarks of their respective owners.
